titleEn: Smart drainage tech helps farmers control water table remotely
titleZh: 智能排水技术助力农户远程调控地下水位
summaryZh: Agri Drain公司推出智能排水系统，通过地下闸门和云连接技术，让农户用智能手机远程监测和调控田间地下水位。该系统可在干旱时保水、雨涝时排水，维持土壤水分均衡，减少硝酸盐淋溶约40%，兼具农艺与环保效益。文章介绍了系统原理、适用场景（坡度1%以下地块）及灌溉场景应用，为种植业精准水分管理提供了新思路。
featuredReason: 该技术将物联网远程控制与精准水分管理结合，虽面向大田作物，但其"智能调控+云端监测"的架构对智慧畜牧中的牧场水资源管理、粪污处理及饲草种植具有直接借鉴价值。

Smart drainage tech helps farmers control water table remotely

Automated system lets growers adjust field saturation from their smartphone, reducing risks during unpredictable weather.

Andy Castillo,Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery,Farm ProgressAugust 21, 2026

schedule3 Min Read

Agri Drain’s Smart Drainage System uses underground gates to manage water tables, helping farmers retain moisture during dry periods and drain excess water when needed. Agri Drain

Managing water is key to a successful growing season. Farmers can’t control precipitation, but they can adjust saturation using technology.

“We know that with the weather over the last 20 years we’re still getting about the same amount of total moisture every year in the Corn Belt,” said Scott Lukan, CEO of Agri Drain. “But the span in between moisture events, rain, is longer. It’s growing. This means that rain events have to be more intense if you’re still getting the same amount of moisture.”

Based in Iowa, Agri Drain makes water management products for many industries, including agriculture. Focused on controlling water tables with technology, the company created the automated Smart Drainage System. It lets farmers monitor and remotely control a field’s water table from their smartphone, adjusting as needed. It’s an automated water-level control structure installed in line within existing mains or submains, functioning as an adjustable underground dam.

Related:How to avoid being hustled by AI slop

Within the device, a series of gates control the field’s water elevation. What’s the benefit? A consistent water profile. The dams can be opened when the soil is adequately saturated and closed when there isn’t enough water to retain what little is available. It can be adjusted manually, on a calendar basis, via Bluetooth or remotely through mobile connectivity connected to the cloud.

“You’re not irrigating, but you are mitigating risk,” Lukan said. “If it’s 3 days in between rainstorms when you have available moisture and then get more rain, it’s building [saturation] higher in the soil profile because you didn’t drain the water table down to the tile.”

Application for irrigators

Agri Drain’s Smart Drainage System is not just built for farmers watering via precipitation. It’s for irrigators, too. Closing the system when center pivots are running maintains that even saturation level. When closed, water from wells or recycled drainage captured in retention ponds can be pumped back into the control structure to raise the water table.

There are agronomic benefits, too. Controlling drainage creates “a consistent moisture level and [efficient] use of nitrates,” Lukan said. “Without the presence of moisture, we know that the plant doesn’t take up nitrogen.”

In his area, fields need to be fully drained only a few months out of the year. A controlled water table means less input loss and higher plant quality — optimal conditions for their fields.

“Once I’ve planted, you might say, ‘Well, I’m going to bring [the water table] up to 20 inches below the soil surface.’ Then maybe in mid-June or early July, you might say, ‘Now I’m going to bring it down to 28 or 30 inches to mature corn root depth,’ then hold it there,” he said.

Related:Stressed by crop scouting? Plant sensors and robots may help

Where it works best

In a field trial in Illinois in 2020-21, drought cracked the ground right down to the tile.

“When there was an opportune 0.5-inch, 1-inch thunderstorm that came over, that moisture went right down the cracks to the tile and escaped,” Lukan said. Conversely, the Smart Drainage-equipped field’s profile recovered faster.

Beyond agronomic productivity, Lukan also noted conservation benefits. From November to March, during the fallow season, the drainage system prevents nitrates from draining into watersheds. Several studies from institutions across the Midwest, including Michigan State University, the University of Minnesota and Iowa State University, found that managing the water table reduces leaching by about 40%.

Lukan said the smart drainage system works best on fields with 1% or less slope, possibly up to 2%. That’s because flatter fields allow for one control structure to manage them. Sloped fields drain naturally.

“Above 2% of slope is where the benefit of the area that you would be able to manage versus the cost of how many structures it takes starts to diminish,” Lukan said.

About the Author

Andy Castillo

Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery, Farm Progress

Andy Castillo started his career in journalism about a decade ago as a television news cameraperson and producer before transitioning to a regional newspaper covering western Massachusetts, where he wrote about local farming. Between military deployments with the Air Force and covering the news, he earned an MFA in creative nonfiction writing from Bay Path University, building on the English degree he earned from the University of Massachusetts Amherst. In his role at Farm Progress, Castillo covers agricultural technology, new machinery and the constantly evolving farm equipment marketplace.

Castillo splits his time between the open road and western Massachusetts with his wife, Brianna, a travel nurse who specializes in pediatric oncology, and their rescue pup, Rio. When not attending farm shows, Castillo enjoys playing music, snowboarding, writing, cooking and restoring their 1920 craftsman bungalow. You can find Castillo at farm machinery shows across the country.

translationZh:
水资源管理是种植季成功的关键。农户无法控制降水，但可以通过技术来调节土壤饱和度。

Agri Drain公司首席执行官斯科特·卢坎表示：“我们知道，过去20年的天气数据显示，玉米带每年的总降水量大致相同。但降水事件之间的间隔时间变长了，而且还在继续拉长。这意味着，如果总降水量不变，单次降雨事件的强度就必须更大。”

总部位于艾奥瓦州的Agri Drain公司为包括农业在内的多个行业生产水资源管理产品。该公司专注于利用技术控制地下水位，开发了自动化智能排水系统。它能让农户通过智能手机监测和远程控制田间地下水位，按需调节。这是一种自动化的水位控制结构，安装在现有主管道或分支管道的线路上，起到可调节地下坝的作用。

设备内部设有一系列闸门来控制田间水位高度。好处是什么？即稳定的水分分布。当土壤充分饱和时，闸门可以打开；当水分不足时，闸门关闭以保留仅有的一点水分。该系统可以通过手动、按日历设定、蓝牙或通过连接云端的移动网络进行远程调节。

“你不是在灌溉，而是在降低风险，”卢坎说。“如果两场降雨之间间隔3天，土壤中还有可用水分，然后又下了雨，因为之前没有把地下水位排到暗管深度，土壤剖面中的（饱和水）就会累积得更高。”

**适用于灌溉农户**

Agri Drain的智能排水系统不仅面向依赖自然降水的农户，也适用于灌溉农户。当中心支轴式喷灌机运行时，关闭该系统可维持均匀的饱和水平。关闭时，来自水井的水或蓄水塘中回收的排水可以泵回控制结构中，以提高地下水位。

该系统还具有农艺效益。控制排水能创造“稳定的水分含量和（高效的）硝酸盐利用”，卢坎说。“我们知道，没有水分，植物就无法吸收氮。”

在他所在的地区，田地每年只需要几个月的时间进行完全排水。可控的地下水位意味着更少的投入损失和更高的作物品质——为田地创造了最佳条件。

“一旦我种下作物，你可能会说，‘嗯，我要把（地下水位）提高到距地表20英寸处。’然后也许在6月中旬或7月初，你可能会说，‘现在我要把它降到28或30英寸，以适应成熟的玉米根系深度，’然后保持在该水平，”他说。

**最佳适用场景**

在2020-2021年伊利诺伊州的一项田间试验中，干旱导致地面开裂，裂缝直通暗管。

“当一场难得的0.5英寸或1英寸的雷阵雨来临时，水分直接沿着裂缝流到暗管里流失了，”卢坎说。相反，配备了智能排水系统的田块，其土壤水分剖面恢复得更快。

除了农艺生产力，卢坎还提到了环保效益。从11月到次年3月的休耕期，排水系统可以防止硝酸盐流入流域。中西部多家机构（包括密歇根州立大学、明尼苏达大学和艾奥瓦州立大学）的多项研究发现，管理地下水位可减少约40%的淋溶。

卢坎表示，智能排水系统在坡度1%或以下（可能达到2%）的田块上效果最佳。这是因为较平坦的田块只需一个控制结构即可管理。坡地则会自然排水。

“坡度超过2%，可管理区域的效益与所需结构数量成本相比，就开始下降了，”卢坎说。
contentHtml: Automated system lets growers adjust field saturation from their smartphone, reducing risks during unpredictable weather.
